name: new-village-crisis
reviewNotes: All 73 source records reviewed. Preserve the human/oni joint village, Karura's exploitation, hostage crisis and the distinction between the lunar 寧靜村 and 夢之村.
たそがれの夢 is rendered 黃昏之夢 as a story term, not identified with an inventory crystal. Records 7/8/60 use two separate companion-name fields; 37/65/70/71 also contain character-name fields.
Preserve the prince's fire rescue, return to hell for intelligence, and the route through the prison basement to a ship in 猴蟹村. All long-dialogue pauses and speaker-name positions retained.
